title: Pride makes simple obedience feel impossible… until God breaks through.
paragraphs:
Pride makes simple obedience feel impossible… until God breaks through.
Sometimes the loudest battles aren’t around us — they’re inside us.
When pride closes the door, obedience opens the path back home.
This is the moment God calls the heart to surrender.
“God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.” — James 4:6
